provenance.method: Normalized-to-display mappings measured live with set-then-read on FL 26.1.3.5570 during the Ember Tides and Parking Lot Moon sessions (MCP-FRICTION-LOG.md), plus the Serum 2 anchors harvested by fruitylink_serum. Points are what FL displayed after the write; formulas are fits through those points. Nothing here is documented by the plugin vendors.

confidence_vocabulary.verified: several live points fit the formula exactly
confidence_vocabulary.measured: live points recorded; between points the table interpolates
confidence_vocabulary.inferred: formula taken from a session helper or reasoned from a neighbouring parameter; not re-measured
confidence_vocabulary.rough: one live point or a level estimate from a render; expect +/- 2 dB or 10 %

kinds.linear: display = a * v + b (optional 'round': true rounds to an integer)
kinds.exp: display = a * base ** v (log-linear, e.g. filter frequencies)
kinds.log_db: display = k * log10(v) + b; v = 0 displays -inf
kinds.table: monotone piecewise-linear interpolation through measured [v, display] points; 'log': true interpolates the display in log space (frequencies, times); outside the measured range the nearest segment is extrapolated
kinds.enum: nearest of the [v, label] anchors; the inverse looks the label up case-insensitively
